subject: Backfill approval request: Senior SWE (comp band exception)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Backfill approval request: Senior SWE (comp band exception)

Team —

Following up on the IC transfer Pilar approved last week (SWE III -> Platform Lead). That move opens a Senior SWE role on the core inference serving team. We want to fill this as an external hire (fast timeline) and need approval for:

- Headcount backfill (replacement for the vacated Sr SWE role)
- Compensation exception: request to offer $195,000 base (Band 3 upper quartile) + $10,000 sign-on, total OTE ~205k. This is above the standard band midpoint for Band 3.

Why the exception:
- Role will cover low-latency serving infra for a high-throughput model; market comps show strong competition (see attached benchmarking).
- Candidate is strong and will shorten ramp time by 6-8 weeks compared to other finalists. Recruiter estimates 2-week acceptance window.
- Hiring manager (me) confirms this is needed to avoid regressions in delivery for Q3 milestones.

Attachments: draft offer letter, comp-band grid, benchmarking CSV.

Requesting: Laura/Aditya — please approve headcount and the comp-band exception. Grace/Markus please confirm People Ops/Finance sign-off process and whether we need a budget transfer or exec approval for the exception.

Next steps I propose if approved: send finalized offer to Kelly Thomas (external candidate) by EOD 5/5, with start date target 6/30.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval request: Senior SWE (comp band exception)

Hannah —

Thanks for the context. Headcount backfill is approved from my side; please update the org chart/Headcount tracker.

About the comp-band exception: I can provisionally approve up to the top of Band 3 for this role, but I need:

- A one-paragraph justification that ties the exception to measurable risk (e.g., delivery impact) — short and specific.
- Finance confirmation that the budget exists in the platform team pool or a proposed offset. Markus, can you confirm by EOD 5/5?
- Grace, People Ops: please confirm whether this requires a formal comp exception form or an exec-level sign-off.

If we get those items, I will sign off on the offer value you requested.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval request: Senior SWE (comp band exception)

Thanks — added the requested one-paragraph justification below (also attached the market benchmarking extract):

"The platform team is carrying two critical low-latency projects (KV caching rewrite and the constant-time batching shim). Losing momentum for >6 weeks risks missing Q3 latency SLAs for one strategic customer (Paramount AI POC) and increases unit cost risk by ~12%. The candidate proposed has prior experience shipping identical KV migration at scale and will limit ramp-to-impact to ~4 weeks. Given the scarcity of engineers with this background, the band exception is necessary to secure the hire quickly and avoid >$120k projected cost of delayed delivery."

I can also reduce the sign-on to $7,500 if that helps approvals — keep base at 195k.

Markus — any comments from Finance on offsetting funds?

-aditya
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval request: Senior SWE (comp band exception)

Appreciate the detail and the cost-risk framing — that helps. Finance confirms there is available headroom in the Platform FY25 budget to cover the proposed base + $10k sign-on without an org-wide reallocation, provided hiring is completed this quarter. Please route the formal comp exception request to People Ops for documentation; we do not require exec-level sign-off unless the base exceeds $200k.

Grace — can you confirm the People Ops intake and whether a formal exception form is required?

-Markus
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: Offer up to $195k base, $10k sign-on (Band 3 exception)

Laura/Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. With Finance confirmation and Aditya's justification, Laura has provisionally approved the comp-band exception. Grace confirmed People Ops only needs the comp-exception form (no exec sign-off). I have uploaded the signed comp-exception doc to the linked Drive (see related links).

Action items complete: 
- Headcount backfill approved and tracker updated.
- People Ops will process the comp-exception form; no exec-level escalation required.
- Marissa: please send the finalized offer (base $195,000, $10,000 sign-on, standard equity grant) to Kelly Thomas by EOD tomorrow. Use the attached offer letter PDF and include standard Redwood benefits doc.

Forwarded for records: attached offer_letter_ParamountAI_KThomas.pdf (draft) and comp-band-grid-2025-Q2.pdf.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
